BiblicalUsage: Gederoth is a place in Palestine, named 2 times in Scripture, in Joshua and 2 Chronicles. The full story of the place lives in the Bible itself, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: I take Gederoth seriously as a real place in God’s story, not a made-up one. That is why its name belongs in this study, even when the Bible says little about it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
